segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Good morning.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Oh, good morning. Is this ... er ... room number 26?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Yes, that's right.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: So is this the Student Job Centre?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: It certainly is. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Well, actually I'm looking for a job- a part-time job. Do you have anything available at the moment?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Ah, yes . . . Are you a registered student? I'm afraid this service is only available to full-time students.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes ... I am. I'm doing a degree in Business Studies. Here's my student card.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Which year are you in?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Well ... I've been at uni for four years but I'm in the Third Year because I took last year off.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Right ... well, let's just have a look at what positions are available at the moment. There's a job working at the reception desk at the Sports Centre, for three evenings a week- that's Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: That sounds like fun but unfortunately I have evening lectures- so that's not possible, I'm afraid. Is there anything during the day?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: OK, that's no good then. Urn. What about cleaning? There's a position for a cleaner at the Child Care Centre.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Right ...

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: But you'd need to be there at 6 am. Does that appeal?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Six o'clock in the morning! Oh, that's far too early for me, I'm afraid. I'd never make it that early in the morning.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Mmm ... Well - there was a position going in the Computer Lab. for three days a week that might be OK. Ah, here it is! No, it's in the Library, not the Lab., Clerical Assistant required- I think it mostly involves putting the books back on the shelves. Oh no- hang on. It's for Wednesday and Friday evenings again.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: No- I can't manage that because of the lectures.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: OK, I'm getting the idea. Look, I'll just get a few details from you anyway, and then we can check through the list and see what comes up.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: We'll fill in the personal details on this application form first, if that's OK?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes, that's fine.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Now, what's your name again?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Anita Newman- that's N-E-W-M-A-N.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: And your address, Anita?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I'm in one of the Halls of Residence for post-graduate students, you know, International House.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: OK- that's easy. What's your room number there?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Roo:n B569- no sorry B659. I always get that wrong. I haven't been living there very long.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Do you have any other skills? Typing, languages, that sort of thing?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Well, I speak some Japanese.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Right, I'll make a note of that. Now - let's see what else is available. What do you think of administrative work? There is a position for an Office Assistant at the English Language Centre.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: That sounds interesting.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: It's for 3 days a week- Monday, Friday and Saturday mornings. Interested?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Mmm. I was hoping to have Saturdays free. But I need the work so ... can you tell me what the job involves?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Yes, sure. It says here that you'll be required to deal with student enquiries and answer the phone.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I'm sure I can handle all that without a problem.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Great. Well, would you like me to arrange an interview for you? Say, Friday morning, around ten?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Could we make it a bit later? Unfortunately, I've got something to do at ten. Would that be OK?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Not a problem. How about eleven thirty? Hope it works out for you Anita.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Me too. And thanks for all your help.
